beats.care: Live or work near Bannerghatta Road? A metro commute is close, but wait for the official opening date.
beats.what: The metro safety commissioner inspected the 7.5 km line on Oct 6–8. BMRCL has replied to its observations; approval is expected this week.
beats.why: No line can carry passengers without the safety commissioner's authorisation. CM Shivakumar has also asked the PM for an opening date.

cards.body: Kalena Agrahara, Hulimavu, IIMB, JP Nagar 4th Phase, Jayadeva Hospital and Tavarekere.
cards.caption: Stations on the stretch

cards.body: BMRCL plans six trains on this stretch: one every 6 minutes at peak hours and every 10 minutes otherwise.
Even after the safety nod, there is no fixed opening date yet. It depends on when the PM can inaugurate it.

opts: Final safety authorisation from the CMRS
cards.q: What is the Pink Line still waiting for before opening?
cards.why: Inspection is done; the safety commissioner's authorisation, expected this week, is the last technical step.

hook: Bannerghatta Road metro is *almost here*. What's still pending?

learn.t: Jayadeva Hospital will become Bengaluru's third metro interchange once this Pink Line stretch opens.
